description: Updates a tag, trigger or variable by its API path. PUT semantics: this is a FULL REPLACE, not a patch — fetch the current resource with get_resource, modify it, and send the whole object back. Pass the resource's last-seen fingerprint for optimistic-concurrency safety; a mismatch fails the request. Requires the tagmanager.edit.containers scope.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint from the last read of this resource; the update fails if it is stale.

path.description: API-relative resource path as returned in the resource's own "path" field, e.g. "accounts/1/containers/2/workspaces/3/triggers/5".

name: update_entity
title: Update a tag, trigger or variable
